title: The pullback of a module generated by sections is generated by sections
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of a module locally generated by sections is again locally generated by sections (author lemma at source lines 965-971, label lemma-pullback-locally-generated). The proof (source lines 973-1010) reduces to a globally generated module by comparing the pullback of a restriction with the pullback along the induced morphism, and then applies the compatibility of the pullback with colimits and its right exactness to the surjection exhibiting the generators (proof lines 974-1007). The reduction to the globally generated case is the content. H2.
